A '''jizz-wailer''' was a musician who specialized in playing [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]] songs. [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]] was the forerunner to the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]].<ref name="The Band's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>
